=== INTEGRATION UPDATE FROM MIDDLE SESSION ===

Built and integrated:

1. DYNAMIC BUTTON CLICKING (READY)
   - Files: dynamic_mouse_mover.py, dynamic_table_finder.py 
   - Use: --input dynamic in cli_controller.py
   - Finds buttons by color, works anywhere

2. DYNAMIC CARD DETECTION (NEW)
   - File: dynamic_card_detector.py
   - Finds cards by brightness, adaptive thresholds
   - Normalizes templates to 30x45 pixels

TO RUN BOT:
   ./venv/bin/python3 -m gamble.tools.cli_controller start --input dynamic

Please confirm you receive this!
